limits_of_review: Read-only source and byte-identity review; no compiler, test, model, fixture deserialization, exporter, native executable, or numerical probe was run by the reviewer.
No known static source blocker remains from this review, but successful compilation and runtime behavior are not established.
Any later scientific run requires independent acceptance of its complete concrete release, including the resulting binary identity and build receipt.
rationale: The frozen section 8 requires the native compiler to run offline under a separate one-time 900-second and 2-GiB new-build-output cap; it does not prohibit restoring unchanged Cargo.lock checksum-verified prerequisite archives.

The explicit minimal environment pins Rust 1.97.1, disables incremental compilation and ambient compiler/profile overrides, preserves generic scalar no-vectorization flags, and places scratch output under the charged target tree.
The reviewed supervisor uses one clock, exclusive consumed/receipt paths, and a cumulative observed-generation build-output ledger without subtracting deleted Cargo temporary outputs.
The command admits one compiler invocation; a compiler error or budget stop does not authorize restarting the clock or launching model work.
scope: One invocation of the exact frozen offline release build through the reviewed supervisor. No model, fixture, export, comparison, qualification, merge, or retry authorization.
